capabilities: copy generated images to the clipboard
disambiguation: Not a website embedder despite the README's opening line; it generates gradient images from text.
extras: The README's first line ('This plugin allows you to embed any website in your Obsidian') contradicts the manifest description and features, and appears to be a copy-paste error; the plugin's actual job per description and features is generating gradient share images.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render text as a styled image suitable for sharing on social media.
summary: Gradient image generator that turns selected text into a shareable image for social media or notes.
